Indirect FIFO Control 0

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x184
Size:
0x4
Source:
usb_ocp_recovery_reg.rdl

Description

INDIRECT_FIFO_CTRL_0: CMS (byte 0), RESET (byte 1), reserved (bytes 2-3). The live owner of these fields is usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv: it captures the host write on the FIFO command path and continuously drives this regblock copy (hw=w), so the regblock is the single read-back source (sw=r). This removes the prior duplication where the regblock held an independent sw=rw copy that the FIFO transport bypassed. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 INDIRECT_FIFO_CTRL command summary.

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name

Field Descriptions

RESERVED_31_16 - Reserved

Bytes 2-3 are reserved.

RESET - Reset

Byte 1 bit 0 requests FIFO reset and the device clears it after use (write 1 to reset the indices). Firmware accesses route through cpuif, while usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv remains the live owner and mirrors the committed state back through hw=w. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 INDIRECT_FIFO_CTRL command summary.

CMS - Component Memory Space

Byte 0 selects the FIFO-backed component memory space. Firmware accesses route through cpuif, while usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv remains the live owner and mirrors the committed state back through hw=w. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 INDIRECT_FIFO_CTRL command summary.
